limitations.statement: The pinned v0.2.0-alpha.1 delivery identifies itself as CANDIDATE_ONLY_NOT_RELEASE_AUTHORIZED.

The exact executable imports app-local-resolvable VCRUNTIME140.dll, but the release and EWB plan bind only the executable; planning remains disabled until the non-platform DLL closure is admitted and locked.
This adapter runs only TomorrowCI's native trust-behavior audit; it does not scan a repository or execute target code.

EWB supplies this operation an EWB-owned, content-addressed empty PATH (and .EXE-only PATHEXT on Windows), so native T5 and T8 intentionally report BLOCKED and cannot launch ambient Docker, Podman, or Git binaries.

EWB verifies the owned PATH directory is real and empty immediately before spawn and keeps it for the child lifetime, but this is not same-user operating-system containment; a concurrent process with the same user authority could still race the directory after verification.

The native overall field is only a preserved projection and is never promoted into workbench authority; upstream may report overall PASS while the deliberately isolated T5 and T8 host probes report BLOCKED.
Capability approval constrains this adapter invocation; it is not an operating-system sandbox.
